messages.text: I need a set of matching plant-shop ads, and I’m probably overthinking how to explain this because I want them to feel like they belong together. I always worry that an ad can look lovely at first glance but become hard to read when you actually try to find the details. The formats I need are 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9, and the wording to include exactly is “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Please use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look across the set. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address, and rearrange things to fit rather than shrinking the whole design.

Your Fern House set is ready: three matching ads, one in each format.

All three use the same design: a cream background, deep forest-green lettering and leafy houseplants (monstera, fern, pothos). The five lines are the same in each, in this order:
"Fern House" → "Weekend Plant Sale" (the big headline) → "20% off all indoor plants" → "Saturday & Sunday" → "Visit 24 Willow Lane"

The address sits on its own solid green bar with cream letters, so it's easy to find. Instead of shrinking one design to fit, I gave each format its own layout. I also asked for the plants to stay clear of the words.

• I couldn't see the finished images from here, so I haven't checked the wording myself. AI image tools sometimes misspell words or drop a small detail, such as the "&" or the "20%". Read each line, especially "Visit 24 Willow Lane".
